data.exact_reserve_text: This result includes the anticipated impact of the recent announcement from the Ministry of Justice, reducing the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) to -0.75%. During the year the Syndicate entered into a significant transaction with a third party organisation, whereby, in return for a reinsurance premium, the Syndicate benefits from 100% reinsurance of certain long tail outstanding claims on 2014 and prior underwriting years. This policy removes reserve uncertainty applicable to the reinsured claims, and is due to be followed by legal transfer of the underlying claims to the reinsurer. The 2016 result also includes the cost of the 2007 and prior year Loss Portfolio Transfer Agreement in respect of the Syndicate's UK & Ireland EL and PL legacy reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2016 were GBP 1,063.737m. The report does not disclose a single explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure. The 2016 result reflects multiple reserve-related items: the anticipated impact of a change in the Ogden discount rate (legal/discount rate development), the inclusion of costs linked to a 2007-and-prior Loss Portfolio Transfer for UK & Ireland EL and PL legacy reserves, and a 2016 transaction providing 100% reinsurance of certain long-tail 2014-and-prior claims which removes reserve uncertainty. These items affect casualty and professional lines and have resulted in a mixed picture for prior-year development with no clearly stated gross PYD amount in the accounts.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was identified in the notes. A net claims development triangle (net of reinsurance) is present and shows effectively no net prior-year development; however the triangle is net (not gross). The report contains narrative of transactions (100% reinsurance of certain long-tail 2014-and-prior claims and the 2007-and-prior LPT) and the Ogden discount rate impact, but no gross PYD amount. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null rather than inferring a gross value from net or other indirect sources.
